rulings.Case Title: THE ESTATE OF MAKO U ROVA
rulings.Calendar Matter: PETITION FOR LETTERS OF ADMINISTRATION WITH WILL ANNEXED, Appointment Under IAEA
rulings.Rulings: Continued to 9/14/26. (No earlier availability.) Issue(s) necessitating continuance: (1) Notice must have attached to it the procedures for how to make a remote appearance by Zoom and CourtCall, as well as remote public access, as set out at https://sf.courts.ca.gov/divisions/probate-court. [LRSF 14.1 C.6.] (2) The mailed notice does not show that Petitioner seeks to admit a LOST will. (3) A petitioner may not serve notice of his own petition. (4) The proof of service does not show an address for Gaku Uchida. (5) There is no Attachment 3g(1)(c) to the petition. No one appears to have standing to nominate. [Prob. C. Sect. 8402.] (6) The public administrator has priority before creditors and any other person. (7) The first named executor is Atsuko Jurenes, not Futaai Uchida, as alleged in item 3g(2) of the petition. (8) Atsuko Jurenes is not listed in item 8 of the petition and did not receive notice. (9) Is Yoshihiro Uchida, who is named in the will, the same person as Yoshihiro Tanaka? (10) A copy of the lost will does not appear to have been filed. (11) There is no other petition before the Court. William Lynch and Philis Lynch do not appear to be interested parties. It appears that an amended petition should be filed. An amended pleading requires the same notice of hearing (including publication) as the pleading it amends. [CRC 7.53(a).] Courtesy copies of any papers filed to address these issues must be received by the assigned examiner by no later than 8/31/26. Please remember that notice must not be mailed before the pleading requiring notice actually e-filed and viewable on the register of actions. Examiner continuances are final and not subject to contest under LRSF 14.10 B.

rulings.Calendar Matter: ACCOUNTING PETITION RE: Report
rulings.Rulings: Continued to 8/31/26. (No earlier availability.) (1) Detailed schedules of receipts and gains and losses on sale must be filed to support the statutory fee. [CRC 7.705(b) and 7.550(b)(6).] (2) If time was billed by a paralegal, the fee declaration must include a statement addressing his/her qualifications regarding the requirements of, and compliance with, Business & Professions Code Section 6450, including the continuing education requirements. Deadline to provide the assigned examiner courtesy copies of papers filed to address these issues is 8/17/26. (The "amendment and supplement" filed on 5/26/26 is actually a fully amended petition. [CRC 7.3.] No order for final distribution has been entered yet, so the proposed order should not be an "amended" order.) An appearance may be required after all issues have been addressed, as the statutory fee appears to be more than twice the actual time spent on ordinary services. Examiner continuances are final and not subject to contest under LRSF 14.10.B.

rulings.Calendar Matter: ADDED TO CALENDAR FOR Status Hearing Re Appointment Of Referee
rulings.Rulings: No appearance required. This status hearing is off calendar. See below: The Court appoints HON. Accordingly, the Court instructs the parties to jointly complete and submit Judicial Council form ADR-110, ORDER APPOINTING REFEREE to Department 204 by August 24, 2026, at 5 p.m. Refer to the form attached in Attachment B to JOINT NOTICE ON STATUS OF MEDIATION filed on May 11, 2026. Item 3 must be completed, and Item 9 must include the referee's signature. The Court sets a compliance hearing for August 31, 2026, at 9:00 a.m. in Department 204 regarding submission of Judicial Council form ADR-110 ORDER APPOINTING REFEREE. If the form is properly submitted by August 24, 2026, at 5 p.m., the hearing may be taken off calendar.

rulings.Case Title: THE ESTATE OF ARIS GIANNAKAKIS SAVVIDIS
rulings.Calendar Matter: PETITION FOR LETTERS OF ADMINISTRATION, Appointment Under IAEA
rulings.Rulings: Continued to 9/21/26. (No earlier availability.) Issue(s) necessitating continuance: (1) The ex parte petition filed on 6/26/26 did not come to the attention of any court staff as it was merely filed and further steps were not taken, as set forth in LRSF 14.11 B. No courtesy copy was apparently delivered to the file clerk, along with a proposed order, for the ex parte petition to be input in the tracking database and assigned to an examiner by the director. A guardian ad litem is necessary to represent the interest of the minor heir because some or all of the estate could be separate property, not because the examiner requires it. (2) No proof of service has been filed. [LRSF 14.14 C.] (3) Only names without addresses were listed on Attachment 7a. (4) No proposed order appointing the guardian ad litem has been provided. (5) The attorney represents Lorena Campozano, not the estate of Aris Giannakakis, and Loreana Campozano is not yet the personal representative of the estate. Please provide a courtesy copy of the petitioner's verified supplement to her ex parte Petition for Appointment of Guardian ad Litem, proof of service of notice, and a proposed order appointing a guardian ad litem to the assigned examiner well before the 9/21/26 hearing, so that, if the guardian ad litem is appointed, he can receive or waive notice and waive bond, if he feels it is in the minor's best interest. Examiner continuances are final and not subject to contest under LRSF 14.10 B.

rulings.Case Title: THE ESTATE OF SHIRLEY C. YAWITZ
rulings.Calendar Matter: PETITION FOR PROBATE OF WILL AND FOR LETTERS TESTAMENTARY
rulings.Rulings: Continued to 09/14/2026. Issues necessitating continuance: 1) Petition is incomplete and/or inconsistent: the caption does not indicate that limited IAEA authority is requested, although Item 2c does indicate limited IAEA authority is requested. Additionally, the notice of petition to administer estate and the published notice do not reflect IAEA authority. Item 4 is not checked but appears to apply. The declaration of due diligence references an attachment one from Heir Pros, but there is no attachment one or report from Heir Pros. 2) The will does not waive bond, and the petition indicates an estimated estate valued at $2,500,000, with real property estimated to be valued at $2 million. With limited authority, please explain why bond is not requested to be $500,000. Please address the above issues and delivery courtesy copies of all further filings to this examiner no later than 08/31/2026 to avoid additional continuance.
